description: This Java class defines configuration properties for Hono's registration API, specifically handling the maximum number of devices per tenant and the default device identities filename.

classes.name: FileBasedRegistrationConfigProperties
classes.description: Configuration properties class for device registration, extending base registry config properties with specific settings for max devices per tenant and default filename.

methods.name: getMaxDevicesPerTenant
methods.description: Retrieves the maximum number of devices that can be registered for each tenant.

methods.name: setMaxDevicesPerTenant
methods.description: Sets the maximum number of devices per tenant, throws IllegalArgumentException if the input is less than or equal to zero.

methods.name: getDefaultFileName
methods.description: Overrides method to return the default filename for device identities.
